text: Explain fundamental database concepts, DBMS architecture, and the relational data model.
Design an entity-relationship model for a given application domain and map it to a relational schema.
Formulate queries over a relational database using relational algebra and SQL.
Analyse functional dependencies in a relation and apply normalisation up to BCNF to eliminate update anomalies.
Evaluate transaction concurrency control and recovery mechanisms for correctness under concurrent execution.
Assess indexing structures and query-optimisation strategies, and justify a design choice for a given workload.
